subject: AWS listing: translation checklist, procurement snippets, and launch readiness
messages:
From: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@sparrowanalytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sparrowanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing content + translations for EU/US launch

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Sparrow is targeting a soft launch of the AWS listing (US & EU) the week of Sep 20. We had two immediate asks so we can lock the procurement snippet and localization work with our legal/procure teams: 

1) A short, procurement-ready blurb (2–3 sentences) that explains how billing appears on invoices and any reseller/partner pass-through language. Our procurement team needs that for vendor onboarding.
2) A translation-friendly hero and 3 bullets file (source English + guidance on character limits and tone) so our localization vendor can slot text into the marketplace UI. The EU storefront needs a tighter 80–100 char headline cap compared to US.

I attached the current hero draft (hero_copy_v3.docx) and our pricing table (pricing_table.csv) so you can see SKU mapping. Can your team produce the procurement snippet and a translation checklist by EOD Sep 8? If not, what's realistic?

Also — we may need a DS/PO signature by Sep 15; I put procurement on cc to flag timing.

Thanks,
Emma Lewis
Head of GTM Partnerships
Sparrow Analytics

--
Attachment stubs: hero_copy_v3.docx (docx), pricing_table.csv (csv)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@sparrowanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing content + translations for EU/US launch

Thanks Emma — good notes and timeline.

Quick plan: 
- Kimberley (cc) will draft a procurement-ready blurb and a one‑line invoice label that maps to the SKU names in your pricing_table.csv.
- I will assemble a translation checklist with character limits and placeholders for contextual notes (examples: whether acronyms should be expanded, legal claim equivalences). I dropped a starter file (translation_checklist.xlsx) into the thread.
- Jonas — can you confirm whether the EU hero should be localized for formal tone or kept neutral? That affects the suggested length.

Deliverables & timeline:
- Procurement snippet + invoice label: Sep 8 COB (internal draft)
- Translation checklist + hero variants: Sep 9 morning
- Finalized listing copy (ready for upload): Sep 12

One ask for you, Emma: procurement teams often want exact wording for the "bill to" line — would their PO team accept the phrase we typically use: "Redwood Inference (charge via AWS Marketplace)"? If Sparrow needs a different vendor line we can adapt.

I attached the translation checklist stub to this reply.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partner Marketing
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: translation_checklist.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@sparrowanalytics.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing content + translations for EU/US launch

Emma — draft procurement snippet below (keeps invoicing and passthrough language explicit):

"Sparrow Analytics purchases Redwood Inference via AWS Marketplace. Charges will appear on your AWS invoice as "Redwood Inference/Redwood Inference (Marketplace)", and may be billed by AWS on behalf of Redwood. For reseller or partner pass-through clarifications, contact procurement@sparrowanalytics.com."

Invoice label (compact): Redwood Inference (AWS Marketplace)

Localization guidance (high level):
- US hero headline target: 110 characters max.
- EU hero headline target: 95 characters max; prefer formal register for legal/regulatory customers.
- Bullet lengths: 1 short (<=90 chars), 2 medium (<=120 chars), 3 longer (<=160 chars).
- Avoid punctuation-heavy trademarks in the hero; provide bracketed contextual notes for translators.

I've also added a short procurement checklist and a one-paragraph sample for contract terms in procurement_snippets_v1.txt (attached).

Olga — if that looks OK, I can sync with Legal to confirm the exact vendor label before we finalize.

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: procurement_snippets_v1.txt

From: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@sparrowanalytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sparrowanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing content + translations for EU/US launch

Perfect — this is exactly what procurement needed. Confirming Sparrow will accept the invoice label: "Redwood Inference (AWS Marketplace)".

Procurement will circulate an internal PO and route a DocuSign to your finance contact (link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-PO-345) by Sep 13. We're pushing the localization vendor to start once they receive the translation_checklist.xlsx; they asked for character caps which you provided.

If anything changes on our side (formatting requirements for EU regional terms), I'll flag it in this thread. Otherwise please proceed with the Sep 12 upload target.

Thanks all — looking forward to the go-live.

Best,
Emma
Head of GTM Partnerships
Sparrow Analytics
